header: The status line of a self-refreshing card: a pulsing dot and LIVE (or PAUSED, or NOT UPDATING when the last check failed), when the figures were fetched, how long until the next check, a thin bar that runs down as the seconds pass, a button to pause the checking, and one to check now. The countdown is its own small component with its own clock, so I keep the list under it from being redrawn every second.

symbols.name: clock
doc: Gives "3:42:10 pm" in Indian time, to the second, because a live screen shows seconds.
